heading: Questions that cross boundaries
body: My research examines how ecological processes connect aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, with particular emphasis on the movement of energy, nutrients, and contaminants through food webs. I combine field studies, stable isotope analysis, fatty-acid biomarkers, and ecological modeling to investigate the mechanisms that structure ecological communities and how these relationships respond to environmental change.

items.title: Cross-Ecosystem Resource Flows
items.description: Understanding how energy, nutrients, and contaminants move between aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems and influence consumers and food webs.

projects.title: Aquatic insect emergence and terrestrial consumers
projects.description: Investigating how emerging aquatic insects support terrestrial predators and influence resource use and physiology across freshwater–terrestrial boundaries.

projects.title: Elephant dung subsidies in river food webs
projects.description: Examining how elephant-derived organic matter enters aquatic food webs and contributes to the diets of invertebrates and fishes.

projects.title: Mercury transfer across freshwater–terrestrial boundaries
projects.description: Using aquatic insects and terrestrial spiders to investigate mercury exposure and movement across connected ecosystems.

items.title: Food Web Structure and Dynamics
items.description: Investigating trophic interactions, resource pathways, and food web organization across freshwater and coastal ecosystems.

projects.title: Food webs in restored and natural coastal marshes
projects.description: Comparing trophic structure and resource pathways across coastal marshes to understand how restoration and freshwater management influence ecosystem functioning.

projects.title: Hydroperiod and ephemeral wetland food webs
projects.description: Examining how variation in wetland hydroperiod influences trophic position, resource reliance, and isotopic niche structure.

projects.title: Modeling coastal food web responses
projects.description: Integrating field observations and ecological models to explore how freshwater management and environmental change influence coastal food webs.

items.title: Environmental Change and Ecological Responses
items.description: Examining how climate, hydrology, land use, and other environmental drivers influence ecological interactions and biodiversity.

projects.title: Threatened Odonata in Zimbabwe's Eastern Highlands
projects.description: Combining field surveys and species distribution modeling to investigate habitat suitability and conservation needs of threatened dragonflies and damselflies.

projects.title: African freshwater biodiversity patterns
projects.description: Investigating geographic patterns in freshwater biodiversity records and conservation knowledge across African aquatic ecosystems.
